slides.sub: Não é só velocidade. É arquitetura, privacidade e controle.

posts.legenda:
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next rodando localmente em hardware de consumo muda uma parte importante da conversa sobre IA privada.

A fonte cita execução em Windows ou Linux, com GPU NVIDIA ou AMD de 12 GB ou mais, API local compatível com OpenAI e Anthropic, e um ponto central: nada sai do PC. Também traz números de velocidade em máquinas comuns, com casos acima de 60 tokens por segundo.

Minha leitura é menos sobre benchmark e mais sobre arquitetura. Quando modelos grandes passam a rodar localmente em hardware mais acessível, fica mais viável desenhar agentes com mais privacidade, custo previsível e controle operacional.

É aí que muita empresa trava. O piloto até funciona. Mas produção exige governança, integração e trilha de auditoria quando algo dá errado.

Eu já resolvi isso em uma conta enterprise: plataforma multiagente em produção, conta de US$ 5,5 milhões, cerca de 60% de ganho de eficiência e log de defeitos auditado.

Lançar o agente é uma etapa. Colocar para operar com controle é outra. E é essa segunda que decide resultado.

en.subtitulo: It’s not just about speed. It’s about architecture, privacy, and control.

slides.eyebrow: AI ON THE RISE · PRIVATE AI
slides.headline: Running AI locally on standard hardware changes the equation
slides.sub: It’s not just about speed. It’s about architecture, privacy, and control.

slides.headline: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next already runs on a standard PC with Strata
slides.body: According to the repository, the model can run on Windows or Linux, on NVIDIA or AMD GPUs with 12 GB or more, with a local API compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic. The idea is simple: nothing leaves the PC.

slides.headline: What I see in companies when this lands on the table
items: The pilot works, but no one finalizes the production architecture

slides.headline: Simple that works is worth more than complex that impresses.
slides.body: In practice, this opens room to redesign architecture in companies where privacy, predictable cost, and reliability matter more than a pretty demo. If it’s already possible to run locally with more control, it becomes more viable to put it into production with governance.

slides.eyebrow: WANT TO SEE HOW I DID IT?

en.legenda:
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next running locally on consumer hardware changes an important part of the conversation about private AI.

The source mentions running on Windows or Linux, with an NVIDIA or AMD GPU of 12 GB or more, a local API compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic, and one central point: nothing leaves the PC. It also brings speed numbers on standard machines, with cases above 60 tokens per second.

My take is less about benchmark numbers and more about architecture. When large models can run locally on more accessible hardware, it becomes more viable to design agents with more privacy, predictable cost, and operational control.

That’s where many companies get stuck. The pilot may work. But production requires governance, integration, and an audit trail when something goes wrong.

I’ve already solved this in an enterprise account: multi-agent platform in production, US$ 5.5 million account, around 60% efficiency gain, and audited defect log.

Launching the agent is one step. Getting it to operate with control is another. And it’s the second one that determines results.

Именно здесь у многих компаний всё стопорится. Пилот даже может работать. Но продакшн требует governance, интеграции и аудиторского следа, когда что-то идёт не так.

posts.titulo: IA sem teto de gasto vira risco aberto no caixa
posts.subtitulo: Agentes autônomos aumentam uso. Sem limite duro, o erro fica caro.
posts.tema: IA precisa de teto de custo por padrão nas empresas

slides.eyebrow: IA EM ALTA · TETO DE CUSTO
slides.headline: IA sem teto de gasto vira risco aberto no caixa
slides.sub:
Agentes autônomos aumentam uso.
Sem limite duro, o erro fica caro.

slides.headline: A defesa agora é limite financeiro duro por padrão
slides.body: A proposta é simples: serviços cobrados por uso deveriam cortar a operação ao bater o orçamento mensal. Aviso por e-mail não basta. A leitura da fonte é que, com agentes e automações, o risco de consumo descontrolado aumenta.

slides.label: Conta surpresa que empresas preferem evitar
slides.sub: A fonte diz que muitos preferem erro no sistema a uma fatura inesperada.

slides.headline: O que eu vejo nas empresas quando isso vai pra produção
items: Tem agente rodando sem limite claro de consumo por tarefa ou projeto
Tem piloto bonito sem regra de pausa quando custo sai do esperado
Tem uso sem observabilidade suficiente para saber onde o gasto nasceu

slides.headline: Isso liga direto ao que fiz em uma conta enterprise
items: Plataforma multiagente em produção em uma conta enterprise
Projeto em uma conta de US$ 5,5 milhões
Multiagente em produção exige log de defeitos auditado

slides.headline: Medir em vez de assumir.
slides.body: Na prática, governança de IA não começa no modelo. Começa em limite operacional, limite financeiro e rastreabilidade. Se eu não sei quanto pode gastar, quando para e onde falhou, eu não tenho produção. Eu tenho exposição.

slides.headline: Comenta AGENTES.
slides.body: Te mando no direct o passo a passo do case. Eu tiro IA do papel e coloco em produção, com resultado medido.

posts.legenda:
A discussão sobre hard budget caps faz sentido por um motivo simples: IA em produção consome recurso de verdade. API, storage, compute, workflow. Quando isso roda com mais autonomia, o risco deixa de ser técnico e vira financeiro.

A fonte defende um ponto objetivo: limite duro por padrão. Bateu o orçamento mensal, pausa. Aviso por e-mail não resolve quando o consumo acelera fora do horário ou escala sem controle.

O que eu vejo nas empresas é o mesmo padrão: colocam agente para rodar, mas sem teto de custo, sem regra clara de interrupção e sem observabilidade suficiente para entender onde o gasto nasceu. Aí o piloto parece funcionar, mas a operação fica exposta.

Eu já resolvi isso em uma conta enterprise: plataforma multiagente em produção, em uma conta de US$ 5,5 milhões. Com cerca de 60% de ganho de eficiência. E com um requisito que eu considero básico nesse nível: multiagente em produção exige log de defeitos auditado.

IA sem limite e sem medição não é maturidade. É risco.

Comenta AGENTES que eu te mando no direct como fiz.

en.titulo: AI without a spending cap becomes an open cash-flow risk
en.subtitulo: Autonomous agents increase usage. Without a hard limit, mistakes get expensive.

slides.eyebrow: AI ON THE RISE · COST CEILING
slides.headline: AI without a spending cap becomes an open cash-flow risk
slides.sub:
Autonomous agents increase usage.
Without a hard limit, mistakes get expensive.

slides.headline: The defense now is a hard financial limit by default
slides.body: The idea is simple: usage-based services should stop the operation when they hit the monthly budget. An email warning is not enough. The source’s take is that, with agents and automations, the risk of uncontrolled consumption increases.

slides.label: The surprise bill companies would rather avoid
slides.sub: The source says many would prefer a system error over an unexpected invoice.

slides.headline: What I see in companies when this goes into production
items: There’s an agent running without a clear consumption limit per task or project
There’s a polished pilot with no pause rule when costs go beyond expectations
There’s usage without enough observability to know where the spending started

slides.headline: This connects directly to what I did in an enterprise account
items: Multi-agent platform in production in an enterprise account
Project in a US$ 5.5 million account
Multi-agent in production requires an audited defect log

slides.headline: Measure instead of assume.
slides.body: In practice, AI governance does not start with the model. It starts with operational limits, financial limits, and traceability. If I don’t know how much it can spend, when it stops, and where it failed, I don’t have production. I have exposure.

slides.eyebrow: WANT TO SEE HOW I DID IT?
slides.headline: Comment AGENTES.
slides.body: I’ll send you the case step by step in DM. I take AI off the drawing board and put it into production, with measured results.

en.legenda:
The discussion around hard budget caps makes sense for one simple reason: AI in production consumes real resources. API, storage, compute, workflow. When that runs with more autonomy, the risk stops being technical and becomes financial.

The source argues for one objective point: a hard limit by default. Once the monthly budget is hit, pause. An email warning does not solve it when consumption accelerates after hours or scales without control.

What I see in companies is the same pattern: they put an agent into operation, but without a cost ceiling, without a clear stop rule, and without enough observability to understand where the spending started. Then the pilot seems to work, but the operation stays exposed.

I’ve already solved this in an enterprise account: a multi-agent platform in production, in a US$ 5.5 million account. With about 60% efficiency gains. And with a requirement I consider basic at that level: multi-agent in production requires an audited defect log.

AI without limits and without measurement is not maturity. It’s risk.

Comment AGENTES and I’ll send you in DM how I did it.

Sources: simonwillison.net

ru.titulo: ИИ без лимита расходов превращается в прямой риск для бюджета
ru.subtitulo: Автономные агенты увеличивают использование. Без жёсткого лимита ошибка обходится дорого.

slides.headline: ИИ без лимита расходов превращается в прямой риск для бюджета
slides.sub:
Автономные агенты увеличивают использование.
Без жёсткого лимита ошибка обходится дорого.

slides.headline: Теперь защита по умолчанию — жёсткий финансовый лимит
slides.body: Идея простая: сервисы с оплатой по использованию должны останавливать работу, когда достигают месячного бюджета. Предупреждения по email недостаточно. По мнению источника, с агентами и автоматизациями риск неконтролируемого потребления растёт.

slides.label: Неожиданный счёт, которого компании предпочитают избегать
slides.sub: Источник говорит, что многие предпочтут системную ошибку неожиданному счёту.

slides.headline: Что я вижу в компаниях, когда это уходит в прод
items: Агент работает без понятного лимита потребления на задачу или проект
Есть красивый пилот, но нет правила паузы, когда расходы выходят за ожидаемые рамки
Есть использование без достаточной наблюдаемости, чтобы понять, откуда появился расход

slides.headline: Это напрямую связано с тем, что я сделал в одном enterprise-аккаунте
items: Мультиагентная платформа в проде в enterprise-аккаунте
Проект в аккаунте на US$ 5,5 миллиона
Мультиагент в проде требует аудируемый лог дефектов

slides.headline: Измерять, а не предполагать.
slides.body: На практике управление ИИ начинается не с модели. Оно начинается с операционных лимитов, финансовых лимитов и трассируемости. Если я не знаю, сколько это может потратить, когда это останавливается и где произошёл сбой, значит, у меня не прод. У меня зона риска.

slides.eyebrow: ХОТИТЕ ПОСМОТРЕТЬ, КАК Я ЭТО СДЕЛАЛ?
slides.headline: Напишите AGENTES.
slides.body: Я отправлю в direct пошаговый разбор кейса. Я вывожу ИИ из стадии идеи в прод, с измеримым результатом.

ru.legenda:
Обсуждение hard budget caps имеет смысл по одной простой причине: ИИ в проде потребляет реальные ресурсы. API, storage, compute, workflow. Когда всё это работает с большей автономией, риск перестаёт быть техническим и становится финансовым.

Источник отстаивает чёткую позицию: жёсткий лимит по умолчанию. Достигли месячного бюджета — пауза. Предупреждение по email не решает проблему, когда потребление ускоряется вне рабочего времени или масштабируется без контроля.

Я вижу в компаниях один и тот же сценарий: запускают агента, но без потолка расходов, без понятного правила остановки и без достаточной наблюдаемости, чтобы понять, откуда появился расход. В итоге пилот вроде бы работает, но сама операция остаётся под риском.

Я уже решал это в enterprise-аккаунте: мультиагентная платформа в проде, в аккаунте на US$ 5,5 миллиона. С приростом эффективности около 60%. И с требованием, которое я считаю базовым для этого уровня: мультиагент в проде требует аудируемый лог дефектов.

ИИ без лимитов и без измерения — это не зрелость. Это риск.

É exatamente aí que muita iniciativa trava. O piloto funciona, mas ninguém desenhou direito quem acessa o quê, como auditar defeitos e quais limites o agente precisa respeitar.

Eu já resolvi isso com plataforma multiagente em produção numa conta enterprise: conta de US$ 5,5 milhões, cerca de 60% de ganho de eficiência e exigência de log de defeitos auditado.

Lançar agente é fácil. Colocar em produção com controle e resultado medido é outra conversa.

en.titulo: When the agent gets real access, the risk moves to another level
en.subtitulo: Apple tightened Full Disk Access controls in macOS because of agent-related risk

slides.eyebrow: AI ON THE RISE · PERMISSIONS ON MACOS
slides.headline: When the agent gets real access, the risk moves to another level
slides.sub: Apple tightened Full Disk Access controls in macOS because of agent-related risk

slides.headline: Apple will add extra controls to Full Disk Access
slides.body: Apple said some apps use this access in a way that can expose files, emails, messages, and browsing history without the user fully understanding it. And it said that, with more capable and autonomous AI agents, that risk grows substantially.

slides.headline: The technical message was very clear
items: Full access will require very explicit user action
Apple treats this level of access as extraordinary
The risk increases as agents become more capable and autonomous

slides.headline: What I see in companies when the agent moves past the demo
items: They ask for autonomy before defining who can access what
They connect real systems without a clear audit trail
They scale the pilot without well-defined operational limits

slides.headline: I've already seen this in an enterprise account
items: Multi-agent platform in production in an enterprise account
US$ 5.5 million account
About 60% efficiency gain; audited defect log

slides.headline: Launching is not the same as being used.
slides.body: In practice, an agent in production is not just a model and an interface. It's access control, auditing, and operational limits. Without that, it may work in the pilot. But it doesn't become a reliable operation once it touches systems, sensitive data, and real decisions.

Apple announced additional controls for Full Disk Access in macOS. The reason is in the official text: this level of permission can expose files, emails, messages, and browsing history, and the risk grows as AI agents become more capable and autonomous.

For me, the important point isn't just desktop security. It's the message for any company trying to scale agents: when AI moves past the demo and gets access to real systems, permissions, auditing, and operational limits stop being technical details. They become production prerequisites.

That's exactly where a lot of initiatives get stuck. The pilot works, but nobody properly designed who can access what, how to audit defects, and which limits the agent needs to respect.

I've already solved this with a multi-agent platform in production in an enterprise account: a US$ 5.5 million account, about 60% efficiency gain, and a requirement for an audited defect log.

Launching an agent is easy. Putting it into production with control and measured results is a different conversation.

My take is simple: if content and browsing start happening inside AI interfaces, showing up on Google isn't enough. A company needs to be readable by models, understood by them and, above all, cited.

Поэтому я встроил измерения прямо в проект. Годовой отчёт одной из крупнейших косметических компаний Бразилии, переделанный для чтения ИИ, со сборщиком логов с первого дня:

→ 1 427 прочтений ИИ-краулерами, от 8 разных систем
→ 553 обращения, вызванных чьим-то реальным вопросом
→ 60 человек, пришедших на сайт по клику на цитату в ответе ИИ

За 15 дней.

Именно этому методу я учу на тренингах и воркшопах: контент, технический слой и, прежде всего, измерения.

GEO с доказательствами, а не с обещаниями. Напишите мне в директ.
